INTERVIEW EVIDENCE

Reported versus Observed

Recalled past behavior is Reported. Actions directly witnessed during the session are Observed. Narration alone is not observation.

MATCH INSTRUCTIONS AND TABLES

Four consistent categories

Independent: success observed before prompts/help.
Prompted verification: confirms prior success; independence unverified.
Assisted: help or prompted recovery enables success.
Setup/technical failure: assessment blocked; record the cause separately.

Also retain incomplete tasks, withdrawals and timeouts. Unobserved steps remain unverified.
